import copy
import unittest

from solution import filter_inventory


class FilterInventoryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_filters_by_exact_case_sensitive_label_in_order(self):
        records = [
            {"id": 1, "labels": ["red", "sale"]},
            {"id": 2, "labels": ["Red", "new"]},
            {"id": 3, "labels": ["sale"]},
        ]
        result = filter_inventory(records, "sale")
        self.assertEqual([record["id"] for record in result], [1, 3])
        self.assertEqual(filter_inventory(records, "SALE"), [])

    def test_empty_input(self):
        self.assertEqual(filter_inventory([], "anything"), [])

    def test_result_is_deep_copied_without_input_aliases(self):
        records = [{
            "id": 1,
            "labels": ["keep", "blue"],
            "details": {"sizes": ["S", "M"], "metadata": {"active": True}},
        }]
        before = copy.deepcopy(records)
        result = filter_inventory(records, "keep")
        self.assertEqual(result, records)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0], records[0])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["labels"], records[0]["labels"])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["details"], records[0]["details"])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["details"]["sizes"], records[0]["details"]["sizes"])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["details"]["metadata"], records[0]["details"]["metadata"])
        result[0]["labels"].append("changed")
        result[0]["details"]["sizes"][0] = "XL"
        self.assertEqual(records, before)

    def test_separate_results_do_not_alias_each_other(self):
        shared_record = {
            "labels": ["keep"],
            "nested": {"items": [1, 2]},
        }
        records = [shared_record, shared_record]
        result = filter_inventory(records, "keep")
        self.assertEqual(len(result), 2)
        self.assertIsNot(result[0], result[1])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["labels"], result[1]["labels"])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["nested"], result[1]["nested"])
        self.assertIsNot(result[0]["nested"]["items"], result[1]["nested"]["items"])
        result[0]["nested"]["items"].append(3)
        self.assertEqual(result[1]["nested"]["items"], [1, 2])
        self.assertEqual(shared_record["nested"]["items"], [1, 2])

    def test_required_label_and_records_types(self):
        for required_label in [None, 1, True, ["x"]]:
            with self.subTest(required_label=required_label):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    filter_inventory([], required_label)
        for records in [None, (), {}, "records"]:
            with self.subTest(records=records):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    filter_inventory(records, "x")

    def test_malformed_records(self):
        for records in [[1], [None], [["labels"]]]:
            with self.subTest(records=records):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    filter_inventory(records, "x")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            filter_inventory([{"id": 1}], "x")
        for labels in [None, "x", ("x",), [1], ["x", None], [True]]:
            with self.subTest(labels=labels):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    filter_inventory([{"labels": labels}], "x")

    def test_validation_does_not_mutate_input(self):
        records = [{"labels": ["keep"], "nested": [1]}, {"labels": ["other"]}]
        before = copy.deepcopy(records)
        filter_inventory(records, "keep")
        self.assertEqual(records, before)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
